examples.text: Den Hauptwert legte man aber auf den Ausbau der Beziehungen zu den innerdeutschen Bahnen.
examples.translation: However, one puts the most value on extending the connections to railways within Germany.
examples.english: However, one puts the most value on extending the connections to railways within Germany.

examples.text: Bei der Deutschen Lufthansa sind die innerdeutschen Flüge von und nach Frankfurt bzw. München teilweise zu über 50 Prozent mit umsteigenden Passagieren besetzt.
examples.translation: On German Lufthansa, flights within Germany to and from Frankfurt and Munich are sometimes more than 50% occupied by transferring passengers.
examples.english: On German Lufthansa, flights within Germany to and from Frankfurt and Munich are sometimes more than 50% occupied by transferring passengers.

examples.text: Es gibt keine Fluglinie, bei der es wegen dem innerdeutschen Zugverkehr zu Krisensitzungen kam.
examples.translation: There is no airline that didn't end up in a crisis-situation due to railway transport within Germany.
examples.english: There is no airline that didn't end up in a crisis-situation due to railway transport within Germany.

glosses: between East Germany and West Germany

examples.text: Die vielen innerdeutschen Straßen, Wege und Eisenbahnlinien, die diese Grenze schneidet, sind unterbrochen.
examples.translation: The many roads, paths and railways between East and West Germany, which this border cuts through, are interrupted.
examples.english: The many roads, paths and railways between East and West Germany, which this border cuts through, are interrupted.

examples.text: Im Paketverkehr machten die innerdeutschen Sendungen über 10% des jeweiligen Gesamtvolumens der beiden Postverwaltungen aus und lagen damit weit über den Auslandspaketen.
examples.translation: For parcel delivery, shipments between East and West Germany made up over 10% of the total volume of both post offices at that time, and were therefore far more common than international parcels.
examples.english: For parcel delivery, shipments between East and West Germany made up over 10% of the total volume of both post offices at that time, and were therefore far more common than international parcels.

examples.text: Begünstigt wurde der Zusammenhalt durch die seit 1952 zwar nicht mehr offene, aber bis 1961 noch durchlässige innerdeutsche Grenze.
examples.translation: Cohesion was improved by the permeable inner-German border, which although it had not been open since 1952, remained crossable until 1961.
examples.english: Cohesion was improved by the permeable inner-German border, which although it had not been open since 1952, remained crossable until 1961.

glosses: innerhalb Deutschlands seiend; das Verhältnis zwischen verschiedenen Teilen von Deutschland betreffend

examples.text: „Die Opfer der Berliner Mauer sind weitestgehend erforscht. Anders sieht es bei der fast 1400 Kilometer langen innerdeutschen Grenze aus.“
